title: The compile-gate tests that lock the fail-closed verdict types (@ts-expect-error on a vacuous "safe") are never type-checked: Vitest does not type-check and no tsconfig includes test/, so weakening the verdict types keeps them green

evidence.note: Test 5: // @ts-expect-error then const vacuous: RugEvaluation = { verdict: 'safe' }; the runtime assertions only read the test's own literal
Test 4: same pattern for the unknown variant
include is ["src/**/*", "hardhat.config.ts"]: test/ is not type-checked by the CI tsc step
no typecheck option: Vitest transpiles tests without type-checking, so an unused @ts-expect-error is never reported
header: "The test PASSING means tsc --noEmit passed ... tsc will fail and this test file will fail to load" (neither is true)
four @ts-expect-error gates; every runtime assertion reads the test's own literal

sibling_sites_checked: git grep @ts-expect-error over test/unit at the base SHA: anti-rug/types.test.ts:107 and :117, honeypotTypes.test.ts:20, :27, :46 (the HoneypotResult compile gate; labelled in Task 2). .github/workflows/test.yml runs tsc --noEmit only for tsconfig.json, tsconfig.bot.json and dashboard/tsconfig.json, none of which include test/.
severity_rationale: S2: the gate exists to make a vacuous "safe" anti-rug or honeypot verdict unrepresentable (a vacuous honeypot pass is a buy into a honeypot, an S0/S1 loss); it is silently not running, so the discipline it claims to lock can erode with a green suite.
recommendation: Phase 28 / Phase 31: add the test tree to a type-checked project (a tsconfig.test.json in the CI tsc step, or Vitest typecheck mode) and prove the gate RED once by removing the @ts-expect-error.
affected_cases: Test 4: RugEvaluation accepts { verdict:'unknown', reason } with NO signals field
Test 5: Vacuous { verdict:"safe" } without signals fails TypeScript compilation (vacuous-pass unrepresentable)
honeypotTypes.test.ts: Test 1: literal { verdict: 'safe', evidence: {} } fails tsc --noEmit
honeypotTypes.test.ts: Test 2: literal { verdict: 'safe', evidence: { method: ... } } (missing tax fields) fails tsc --noEmit
honeypotTypes.test.ts: Test 4: literal { verdict: 'unsafe', evidence: { method: ... } } (missing reason) fails tsc --noEmit
escaped_regression: Make signals optional on the safe variant of RugEvaluation in src/anti-rug/types.ts: Test 5 stays green (the @ts-expect-error is never compiled and the runtime check reads the literal), and the src tsc step still passes.
